name: Data.conjHolWeight_eq_add_kernelWeight
summary: Entrywise: by the joint harmonic of the fitting auxiliary pair, the lowest K-type is the staircase weight of the pair; split by the sign of the index and rewrite the sums over orders.

steps.claim: Compare at an index c, using the description of the lowest K-type by the joint harmonic of the auxiliary pair of the trivial twist (`Data.fitsParams_auxPair`, `AuxPair.FitsParams.exists_isJointHarmonic`).
Split on the sign of c (±1) and rewrite the sums of the staircase weights over the orders between ord(c) and 6r.
steps.lean:
cases Int.units_eq_one_or (D.signsW j c) <;> simp [*, -Fintype.card_sum, auxPair] <;>
    rw [Finset.sum_subset (s₂ := .Ioo ((untwistedAuxPair j).ord c) (6 * D.r))] <;> grind
